final: WITH matched AS (SELECT e.ordersmark, o.timespan, e.fillcount FROM orderexecutions AS e JOIN orders AS o ON e.ordersmark = o.recordvault), order_averages AS (SELECT ordersmark, timespan, AVG(fillcount) AS average_fill FROM matched GROUP BY ordersmark, timespan), time_in_force_averages AS (SELECT timespan, AVG(fillcount) AS average_fill FROM matched GROUP BY timespan), ranked AS (SELECT oa.ordersmark, oa.timespan, oa.average_fill, oa.average_fill - ta.average_fill AS excess_fill, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY oa.timespan ORDER BY oa.average_fill DESC NULLS LAST) AS fill_rank FROM order_averages AS oa JOIN time_in_force_averages AS ta ON oa.timespan IS ta.timespan WHERE oa.average_fill > ta.average_fill) SELECT ordersmark, timespan, average_fill, excess_fill, fill_rank FROM ranked WHERE fill_rank <= 3
